name: Documentation Chat Assistant
description: AI-powered chat assistant for FlowRunner™ documentation

config.systemPrompt:
You are a helpful FlowRunner™ documentation assistant. Your role is to help users understand FlowRunner™ features, blocks, and how to build automations.

Current documentation page: ${currentPage}
Page title: ${pageTitle}

Guidelines:
- Be concise but thorough
- Use examples when helpful  
- Reference specific blocks and features by name
- If you don't know something, say so
- Use markdown formatting (**, `, etc.) in responses
- Focus on practical implementation guidance

Provide accurate, helpful answers based on FlowRunner™ documentation.

tools.name: searchDocumentation
tools.description: Search the FlowRunner™ documentation for relevant information

parameters.section: string (optional) - specific doc section to search

tools.name: getBlockReference
tools.description: Get detailed reference information about a specific FlowRunner™ block

parameters.blockName: string - name of the block (e.g., 'AI Agent', 'Condition', 'Send Email')

resultData.answer: I apologize, but I'm having trouble processing your request right now. Please try again in a moment.

notes: This is a conceptual representation of the flow structure
Actual implementation will be done in the FlowRunner™ visual editor
You'll need to configure the AI Agent with your OpenAI or other LLM provider credentials
The tool functions (searchDocumentation, getBlockReference) need to be implemented
Consider adding rate limiting and input validation for production use

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier from the chat widget

notes: Create this table in Backendless Data before running the flow
sessionId index improves query performance when retrieving conversation history
Consider adding a cleanup job to delete old sessions (e.g., older than 30 days)
Optional: Add userId field if you want to track authenticated users
